errors.text: The proposed thermo-mechanical rolling and stepwise-aging route does not reconstruct the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2 h HPHT treatment.

The hypothesis substitutes a refractory W-Ni-Fe-Ta alloy mechanism for the target Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic FCC/B2 lamellar alloy without evidence that the required coherent precipitates can form in the target.
It misses the target structural transformation from incoherent FCC/B2 lamellae to a hierarchical pattern with coherent phase interfaces.

The proposed processing sequence is internally inconsistent: the narrative describes lower-temperature nucleation followed by higher-temperature aging, whereas the specified route uses 900 degrees C followed by 650 degrees C.

The predicted strength and ductility do not match the target response of approximately 1150 MPa and 36% elongation, and the proposed route offers no support for such high ductility in the target alloy.
